threads.body: `schema_note()` always injects the full structured-vs-JSON-string guidance. For attributes whose existing `attribute.note` already contains the span guidance (e.g., tool call arguments/results), the rendered notes end up repeating that sentence. Consider making the schema note omit the span clause when the base note already covers it, while still adding the events clause and schema link.
